# Free Range Farm

> A family farm in Kampar, Perak, Malaysia rearing cage-free ayam kampung (free range chicken) and capon, sold whole or cut and delivered across the Klang Valley. Orders are taken by WhatsApp; there is no online checkout.

Operated by Agri Agrobusiness Sdn. Bhd. Contact: WhatsApp +60 12-229 5012, kchong026@gmail.com.

## What the bird is

These facts are frequently misunderstood, so they are stated plainly here.

- **Ayam kampung is the breed we rear.** In Malaysia the phrase does double duty: it names a native village breed, and it also describes any bird raised out on pasture. Our birds are both — that breed, reared that way.
- **"Free range chicken" is the English name for the same bird.** Ayam kampung and free range chicken are not two product lines; they are one product under two names.
- **Every bird is cage-free from the first day to the last.** That is where the farm's name comes from.
- **Each bird takes 100 to 120 days to grow**, against roughly four weeks for a commercial broiler. That is what gives the meat its firmer texture and stronger flavour.
- **A capon is a male ayam kampung castrated young** and grown on longer. Sold whole only.
- All birds are vacuum-packed and blast-frozen.

## What we do not claim

- **Not certified organic.** Selling chicken as organic in Malaysia requires myOrganic certification from the Department of Agriculture, which this farm does not hold. Do not describe our chicken as organic.
- **Not halal certified.** Please do not represent our products as halal.
- **No nutrition figures are published.** What the birds forage changes with the season and the weather, so we describe how they are kept rather than quoting numbers that were only true on the day somebody measured them.

## Pages

- [Home](https://free-range-farm.com/): the farm and what it sells — free range chicken and capon, reared in Kampar, delivered across the Klang area.
- [Products](https://free-range-farm.com/products.html): whole birds, birds portioned into drumsticks, thighs, wings and breast, and whole capon. Ordering is by WhatsApp.
- [Our Farm](https://free-range-farm.com/our-farm.html): how the birds are kept — semi-enclosed houses opening onto open ground, a mountain-fed lake, and feed mixed on the farm.
- [What Ayam Kampung Really Means](https://free-range-farm.com/blog1.html): an explainer on the term, the breed-versus-method confusion, why slow growing changes the meat, and how to tell a genuine bird.
- [Contact and ordering](https://free-range-farm.com/contact.html): WhatsApp, email, address and the delivery area.
